divergence_justification: MIMIC-on-FHIR has no populated ICU input-event/link-order identifier at MedicationAdministration.identifier.value. The ICU ETL selects no linkorderid and uses orderid only inside an opaque UUID calculation (mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_medication_administration_icu.sql:7-23); the emitted resource contains no identifier element (:38-103). Resource IDs cannot be inverted (MIMIC_NOTES.md:203-230). This exactly explains 16,892 differing_null_only rows on linkorderid, with zero missing, candidate-only, or conflicting rows. Overall fidelity is 0.00% solely because that declared column is NULL; representable fidelity is 16,892/16,892 (100.00%). All defensible mappings were exhausted: exact ICU code 221662, ICU Encounter identifier recovery, both effective[x] variants, Quantity casts, and TIMESTAMP_NTZ parsing are implemented. The missing administrative identifier affects neither row inclusion nor the (stay_id,starttime) grain, grouping, carry-forward, or clinically meaningful rate, amount, and timing outputs. There are no divergent dependencies.

reopen_history.reason: Type B cast defect: TRY_TO_TIMESTAMP(REGEXP_REPLACE(col, offset-strip), "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss[.SSSSSS]") returns NULL on any shape the pinned format misses (date-only values especially), and TRY_ makes it silent -- those NULLs reach the judge as differing_null_only/gap_shaped, i.e. a parse failure disguised as a FHIR coverage gap at the lower bar. Replace every datetime mapping with a bare TRY_CAST(col AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ). See pathling-sql SKILL.md and MIMIC_NOTES.md:337.
